newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.
newsitem.headline: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping soybeans and soy products:
Vessels: Uniwersyt. Gdanski loading 46,446 tonnes soybeans. Vick Luk loading 33,000 tonnes soymeal. Waiting to dock, three vessels to load soybeans, three for soymeal and one for mixed cargo.
Road: 990 trucks carrying soybeans arrived between June 27 and 29, as well as 670 trucks with soymeal and 204 trucks with vegetable oils including soyoil.
NOTE: Rain delayed loading over the weekend and Monday.

Vessels: At public terminal, Powhatan loading 57,000 tonnes soymeal. Waiting to dock, one vessel to load soybeans. At Cargill private terminal, Standard Endeavour loading 18,000 tonnes soymeal. No vessels waiting to dock.
